digest.component_or_area: store-wide compaction sweep and authorship ledger building
propositions: The store-wide compaction sweep spawns one `git log --full-history` walk per ticket while holding the global write lock, causing multi-minute stalls and writer starvation.
Per-ticket authorship map misses fall through to per-event wildcard walks with leading pathspecs, defeating pathspec pruning and making the deployed cost worse than the ticket description states.
The sweep never re-yields mid-run; it probes `write_lock_is_busy` once before starting but does not re-probe between tickets, so writers arriving after start wait for the entire run.
The `_commit_backfill` function stages with unscoped `git add -A`, allowing concurrent writers' in-flight event files to be swept into the compaction commit under the wrong message.

Hoisting the position-keyed history walk out of the lock and building it once per sweep before taking any lock moves all git-log cost out of the critical section, reducing the lock hold to SNAPSHOT write, renames, and commit operations.
